question: In Spring 2025, do 15-251 (Section 1: Monday, Wednesday 10:00–11:15) and 15-210 (Thursday, Sunday, Tuesday 14:30–15:45) have a scheduling conflict?
expected_answer: No — 15-251 Section 1 meets Monday and Wednesday 10:00–11:15, while 15-210 meets Thursday, Sunday, and Tuesday 14:30–15:45. These courses share no common meeting days or times, so a student could enroll in both simultaneously.
common_mistake: Assuming because both courses are offered in Spring 2025 they must conflict; not carefully mapping out all meeting days
needs_verification: Confirm there are no recitation or lab sections that might conflict
